sentences.japanese: 多くの人が日常のことについて文を書く。
sentences.english: Most people write about their daily life.

sentences.japanese: もしスペンサーが文を足して訳し続けなければ、他の貢献者がきっと彼を追い抜くだろう。
sentences.english: If Spenser doesn't keep adding and translating sentences, the other contributors will surely surpass him.

sentences.japanese: 君たちはこの文を暗記しさえすればよい。
sentences.english: All you have to do is to learn this sentence by heart.

sentences.japanese: 君たちの文を黒板の文と比較しなさい。
sentences.english: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.

sentences.japanese: 下線のある文を訳しなさい。
